<div class="card-body">
'''Attack Pattern Delta''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">アタックパターン・デルタ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">位置カードで戦闘が宣言された直後に使用する。そこにいるＴ－４７を一機、先頭機として選ぶ。そのターンの終わりまで、同じ位置にいる他のＴ－４７はそれぞれ戦闘力＋１、加えて耐：損耗を得、武器の目標とならない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Attack-Pattern-Delta-PSA-156433120.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">スカイウォーカー中佐と反乱軍の戦術参謀ベリル・シフォナージが考案したスノースピーダー用の攻撃隊形。１列に並び、敵の砲火を先頭機が引き受けて後続機を守る。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Attack Pattern Delta.

'''Card text:'''
Use immediately after a battle is declared at a location. Choose one T-47 there as the lead. Until the end of that turn, each other T-47 at the same location is power +1, immune to attrition, and may not be targeted by weapons.

'''Lore:'''
A snowspeeder attack formation devised by Commander Skywalker and Rebel tactician Beryl Chiffonage. They line up in single file, and the lead ship draws enemy fire to protect those behind.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese chooses one T-47 there as the lead; the English identifies your lead T-47.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Attack Pattern Delta]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
